description:
Get the riskyUserHistoryItems from the history navigation property.

TIP: Lists the risk history for a specific user. Shows how risk level changed over time and what triggered each risk event.

RISK LEVEL: MEDIUM. This response contains PII or authentication metadata (sign-ins, MFA factors, mail metadata, risk detections). Handle with care and avoid casual disclosure.
